content:
The v4.10.0 release of Lean has just arrived!

There are many bugfixes, performance gains, and improvements to the Lean language. Please read the blog post or release notes for details.

We encourage everyone using previous stable releases to update their repositories to v4.10.0.

Batteries, Aesop, ProofWidgets, and Mathlib are all now available for v4.10.0, as well as lean4checker and repl.

  • the stable branch on each repository has been updated to use v4.10.0
  • there is a v4.10.0 tag in each repository if you would like to pin to a commit using this toolchain.
